data.summary:
**When:** [Your Charge phase](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase).

**Target:** An **ACOLYTE HYBRIDS**, **HYBRID METAMORPHS** or **NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS** unit of yours that has not yet **declared a charge** in the phase.

**Effect:** An **[advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** the unit made this turn does not stop it from counting as **eligible to declare a charge**. You can also use this Stratagem's second part as the unit **declares a charge**: if you do, the unit can re-roll its [Charge rolls](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step), and its **charge move** must end in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of an enemy unit that is in Engagement Range of a **CHARACTER** unit of yours.
